properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 17 at 12:19AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a Flood Advisory
for the following rivers in Colorado...

St. Charles River At St Charles R at Vineland affecting Pueblo
County.

For the Saint Charles River...including St Charles R at Vineland...
elevated river levels are forecast.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...St. Charles River at St Charles R at Vineland.

* WHEN...From early this morning until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 10.0 feet, Overbank flow occurs in low spots.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 11:45 PM MDT Sunday the stage was 10.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 4.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall to 2.4 feet Friday
evening.
- Action stage is 10.0 feet.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 17 at 12:15AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 1214 AM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm
just north of Penrose, or 23 miles southwest of Colorado Springs,
moving east at 5 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Penrose.
